changes: Preserved palm and CS sight anchors; lengthened heavy-weapon shot origins shared through fidelity/dimensions.gd
Weapon-specific silhouette corrections: bored double shotgun, wider rotary arrays, fitted donor pistols and energy weapons
LibreQuake bodies for Quake grenade, nail, rocket, super nail and lightning weapons
Starsiege reference silhouettes: stacked laser, flat disc deck, bronze plasma hood and four-barrel chaingun
Krita layered finishes; photographic CS/ST metal and wood grain; per-weapon 512px albedo and roughness/metalness maps with mipmaps
Per-instance breech/slide/pump/hinge/rotary actions and emissive status parts
Small edge bevels, weighted normals, polygon budgets and physical grip checks
Slim UT receivers: distinct single-core caged pulse accelerator versus six-tube rocket launcher; Bio upper assembly 12% wider and 10% taller with unchanged palm and muzzle
Longer Doom chaingun/plasma, UT minigun, Quake super nailgun and ST chaingun; wider Doom/UT rotary arrays
Slimmer ST upper assemblies, donor lower receivers with contoured grips and trigger guards, animated vents/breeches/coils and recessed emissive lenses
CS narrowed palm swells and revised long-gun grip rake; preserved sights, magazine wells and manipulation controls
